outcomes.detail: Rd8+ is the move: it gives check, and their king is shut in by its own pawns on f7, g7 and h7, so it has nowhere to step. They must take with Rxd8, and then Rxd8 is checkmate. This is a back-rank mate: when their king is boxed in behind its pawns, look for a check on the last rank. Next time, before any quiet move, check whether you have a rook check there.
